scope: Collection/identity/derived-metric checks only. Does not alter the already-running secondary or primary scientific protocol.
finite: Strict finite JSON and retained arrays; do not replace markers, delete undefined metrics, silently drop conditions or widen tolerance. An undefined relative metric is retained as a failed metric check, separately from generated-field finiteness.

independent_recalculation.method: For equal-size DDPM/solver amplitude ensembles, exact empirical W1 = mean(abs(sorted(generated_amplitudes)-sorted(solver_amplitudes))), computed in float64 from each native float32 array std. Normalize by native solver-amplitude mean as declared source. This independent rank-pair formula differs from source CDF-area implementation.
independent_recalculation.if_failure: Preserve failure and diagnose; no tolerance change.
independent_recalculation.baseline_scope: Baseline arrays are not retained by frozen secondary; check their reported counts/finite values and summary recomputation only, not independent baseline sample values.

primary_metric_reproduction: Retain measured differences, no new pass tolerance or replacement.
marginal_scope: Frozen secondary does not retain marginal generated fields; only finite values and exact expected counts checked.
